title: SmokePath: choose the structure (your GitHub DESIGN.md stays the material)
question: Every card uses your DESIGN.md look: dark glass, Mona Sans, one green action, CPCB air colours. They differ in how the screen is organised. The roll assigned The School Diary. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The School Diary
options.lineage: the printed school diary every Indian school issues: date header, ruled periods, remarks, parent's signature
options.thesis: Tomorrow arrives as the diary page a principal already reads and signs every evening.
materials: frosted-glass diary page over the live smoke map
hour-ruled lines; changed periods struck through and rewritten
Mona Sans + Devanagari, mono date stamp
options.viewport: Desktop: smoke streams across a full-bleed map; a tall glass diary page for 'Tomorrow · Tue 11 Nov' sits right, its first ruled line is 'Which school?'. Phone: map on top, the page is a bottom sheet with a thumb bar.
options.risk: Turns kitsch if paper textures creep in; the diary must be structure, never costume.

raised.raise: Period state is drawn as line form, not only colour: kept = solid, moved = struck + rewritten, indoors = dashed.
One dominant region per phone screen: the map or the diary page, never both cramped.
Search results and map dots are one space: hovering a school lights its dot, picking flies the map.
Today and Tomorrow are two hard pages with a real page-turn between them.
Periods are drawn to the scale of time, so a moved PE visibly slides down the page to its new slot.

regions.label: diary page: date, periods, remarks, sign

options.label: The Staff-Room Timetable
options.lineage: the period-grid timetable pinned in every staff room
options.thesis: The school day as the period grid principals already plan with, re-planned by the smoke.
materials: glass period grid across the top
smoke map as the band beneath
options.viewport: A wide period grid (Arrival, Assembly, P1–P8, Recess, Dispersal) across the top, each cell in its CPCB colour with changes marked; the smoke map fills the band below; search sits in the grid's corner.
options.risk: Most runs in this category land on a table; it can read like a spreadsheet.

options.label: Pocket Planner App
options.lineage: consumer phone apps: one idea per card, thumb bar
options.thesis: A calm phone app: one card per decision, one green button where something can be done.
options.viewport: Phone-first single column: verdict card, timetable card, parent-message card, smoke card; the map is one tab on the thumb bar.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and is very clear on a phone; the map loses its stage for judges.
options.risk: Generic app feel; the smoke story hides behind a tab.

options.label: Emission-line Rail
options.thesis: State as hairline form on a charcoal continuum.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail carrying every element as ticks.
options.case: Fuses poorly: drops the CPCB colours principals and judges recognise.
options.kept: State carried by line form, so category never relies on colour alone.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful lobes undercut a health decision.
options.kept: One dominant region per screen on phones.

options.label: Event Catalog Grid
options.thesis: Thousands of cells linked to a hall map.
options.viewport: 1,034 schools as a packed grid beside the map.
options.case: Fuses poorly for one principal looking for one school.
options.kept: The list and the map are the same space.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.thesis: Side A / side B halves with a physical flip.
options.viewport: Today and tomorrow as two sides of one card.
options.kept: Today and Tomorrow as hard halves with a real flip.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Time as a vertical staff; length is duration.
options.viewport: The school day as a staff read upward.
options.case: Fuses poorly: upward time confuses a principal.
options.kept: Periods drawn to the scale of time.

canonCard.label: Air-quality dashboard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships: map, sidebar list, big AQI number cards.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar with search and school list, map right, AQI number cards on top.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every AQI app, which you said would feel wrong.
